teaser.en: Its brilliant 'flowers' are really leaves, yet Digo people count them as flowers, and Pakia used it to show why.
teaser.sw: 'Maua' yake yenye rangi angavu kwa kweli ni majani, lakini Wadigo huyahesabu kuwa maua, na Pakia aliutumia mmea huu kueleza sababu.
teaser.dg: 'Maruwage' ganayong'ala kpwa kpweli ni makodza, ela Adigo anagatala dza maruwa, na Pakia wauhumira kuonyesa sababu.

summary.en: Mboganvila is bougainvillea, the thorny climbing shrub from South America with brilliant papery bracts. Pakia uses it to show how the Digo define a flower by colour and function.
summary.sw: Mboganvila ni mbogenvilia (bougainvillea), kichaka chenye miiba kinachotambaa, kutoka Amerika Kusini, chenye vikombe-jani vyembamba kama karatasi na vya rangi angavu. Pakia anautumia kuonyesha jinsi Wadigo wanavyolifafanua ua kwa rangi yake na kazi yake.
summary.dg: *Mboganvila* ni *bougainvillea*, chitsaka chenye miya chinachokpwera, chirichorehwa kula Amerika ya Kusini, chenye *bracts* za rangi zinazong'ala dza karatasi. Pakia anauhumira kuonyesa vira Adigo anavyomanya ruwa kpwa rangiye na kaziye.

about.en: Bougainvillea is a vigorous, thorny climbing shrub. What look like its petals are in fact bracts: papery, brightly coloured leaves, in magenta, purple, red, orange, pink or white, grouped in threes. Each group surrounds three small, tubular, creamy-white true flowers. The ordinary leaves are green, oval and pointed. With pruning it can be kept as a hedge or bush. Left alone, it climbs high over walls and trees.
about.sw: Mbogenvilia ni kichaka kinachotambaa kwa nguvu na chenye miiba. Kinachoonekana kama petali zake kwa kweli ni vikombe-jani (bracts): majani membamba kama karatasi yenye rangi angavu, ya zambarau iliyokolea, zambarau, nyekundu, machungwa, waridi au nyeupe, yaliyopangwa matatu matatu. Kila kundi huzunguka maua halisi matatu madogo, yenye umbo la mrija na rangi nyeupe ya krimu. Majani ya kawaida ni ya kijani, mviringo na yenye ncha. Kikipunguzwa matawi kinaweza kutunzwa kama ua wa mimea au kichaka. Kikiachwa, hupanda juu sana kwenye kuta na miti.
about.dg: *Mboganvila* ni chitsaka chenye miya chinachokpwera na kumera haraka. Vira vinavyoonekana dza vipande vya maruwa kpwa kpweli ni *bracts*: makodza ga rangi zinazong'ala, ganayohalana na karatasi, ga zambarau, ga kundu, ga rangi ya chungbwa, pinki au mereru, ganayokala mahahu-mahahu. Chila fungu rinazunguluka maruwa mahahu madide ga kpweli, ga dza mridza na ga rangi ya maziya. Makodza ga kawaida ni ga chijani, ga mviringo na genye ntsa. Uchiutsatsula, unaweza kuuika dza lichigo au chitsaka. Uchiuricha, unakpwera dzulu sana ya kuta na mihi.

where.en: It is native to South America and is planted throughout the tropics in gardens, hedges and along walls. It does well in the heat and dry spells of the coast.
where.sw: Asili yake ni Amerika Kusini, na hupandwa kila mahali katika nchi za tropiki bustanini, kama ua wa mimea na kando ya kuta. Hustawi vizuri katika joto na vipindi vya ukame vya pwani.
where.dg: Asiliye ni Amerika ya Kusini, na unaphandwa kosi tsi za dzoho mindani, dza lichigo, na kanda-kanda ya kuta. Unamera chinono kpwa dzoho na wakati wa ukame wa pwani.

uses.en: It is grown as an ornamental and for hedges.
uses.sw: Hupandwa kama mmea wa mapambo na kwa kutengeneza ua wa mimea.
uses.dg: Unaphandwa dza mmea wa kupambira na kuhenda lichigo.

culture.en: Pakia uses bougainvillea to explain two Digo plant-part terms. *Kodza*, 'leaf', does not include its coloured bracts, because they are too unlike an ordinary leaf. *Ruwa*, 'flower', does include them, because a *ruwa* is understood by its colour and its role in producing fruit. Scientifically, the bracts are leaves. The Digo category follows how they look and what they do.
culture.sw: Pakia anautumia mbogenvilia kueleza istilahi mbili za Kidigo za sehemu za mmea. *Kodza*, 'jani', haijumuishi vikombe-jani vyake vya rangi, kwa sababu vinatofautiana mno na jani la kawaida. *Ruwa*, 'ua', inavijumuisha, kwa sababu *ruwa* hutambuliwa kwa rangi yake na kazi yake katika kuzaa tunda. Kisayansi, vikombe-jani hivyo ni majani. Kundi la Kidigo linafuata jinsi vinavyoonekana na kazi vinayofanya.
culture.dg: Pakia anahumira *mboganvila* kueleza maneno mairi ga Chidigo ga seemu za mmea. *Kodza*, 'kodza', tarihusu *bracts* za rangi za mmea hinyu, kpwa sababu tazihalana na kodza ra kawaida. *Ruwa*, 'ruwa', rinazihusu, kpwa sababu *ruwa* nkumanyikana kpwa rangiye na kaziye ya kulavya matunda. Kpwa sayansi, *bracts* ni makodza. Kpwa Adigo, zinatalwa kulengana na vira zinavyoonekana na kazi zinazohenda.

names.en: Digo: *mboganvila*, an adaptation of the international name *bougainvillea*, after the French navigator Louis-Antoine de Bougainville. English: bougainvillea.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mboganvila*, jina lililotoholewa kutoka jina la kimataifa *bougainvillea*, kwa heshima ya baharia Mfaransa Louis-Antoine de Bougainville. Kiingereza: *bougainvillea*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mboganvila*, dzina ririrohalwa kula dzina ra kosi duniani *bougainvillea*, ririrolavywa kula dzina ra msafiri wa bahari wa Ufaransa, Louis-Antoine de Bougainville. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *bougainvillea*.

reason.en: Boerhavia, a wild herb of the same family
reason.sw: Boerhavia, mmea-pori wa familia hiyo hiyo
reason.dg: *Boerhavia*, mmea wa weruni wa jamii iyo hiyo

reason.en: Henna, another plant grown around the home
reason.sw: Mhina, mmea mwingine unaopandwa kuzunguka nyumba
reason.dg: *Hina*, mmea wanjina unaophandwa phephi na nyumba

reason.sw: Oleanda ya manjano (yellow oleander), mmea mwingine wa mapambo ulioletwa kutoka nje
Mlangilangi, mmea mwingine wa maua unaopandwa

definition.en: The colourful bracts of bougainvillea are counted as ruwa (flower), not kodza (leaf), because of their colour.
definition.sw: Vikombe-jani vya rangi vya mbogenvilia huhesabiwa kuwa ruwa (ua), si kodza (jani), kwa sababu ya rangi yake.
definition.dg: *Bracts* za rangi za *mboganvila* nkutalwa dza *ruwa* (ruwa), sio *kodza* (kodza), kpwa sababu ya rangi zao.
